name: Computer & Mac Repair
tagline: Slow, broken, or won't boot? We fix it.
description: Diagnostics and repair for Windows PCs, Macs, and laptops — virus and malware removal, data recovery, hardware replacement, OS reinstalls, and speed tune-ups. Most jobs done same week.
buyerProfile: Homeowners and small businesses with a slow, infected, or dead computer who want it diagnosed and fixed without shipping it off or buying a new one.

name: Networking & WiFi
tagline: Kill the dead zones. Make the internet just work.
description: Router, mesh WiFi, and wired network setup for homes and offices. We fix slow connections and dead zones, run and terminate cable, configure VPNs, and lock down your network so it stays fast and secure.
deliverables: Router / mesh system setup and tuning
Business network with VLANs + guest WiFi
buyerProfile: Homes and small offices fighting dead zones, slow WiFi, or a network that drops — who want it set up right once and left reliable.

name: IT Support & Managed IT
tagline: Your on-call IT department — remote or onsite.
description: Remote and onsite IT support for small businesses and busy households. Break-fix help when something goes wrong, plus monthly managed plans that keep your computers, backups, and updates handled so problems never pile up.
buyerProfile: Small businesses and professionals who need reliable tech support without hiring a full-time IT person — and want someone to call when something breaks.

name: Smart Home & Security Cameras
tagline: Cameras, smart devices, and TVs — installed right.
description: Professional install and setup of security cameras, smart-home devices, and home-office tech. We mount, wire, configure the app, and show you how to use it — no boxes left half-installed in a closet.
deliverables: Walkthrough so you actually know how to use it
buyerProfile: Homeowners and small businesses who bought smart-home or camera gear and want it installed, configured, and working on their phone — done by a pro.

name: AI Integration
tagline: Bring AI into the tools you already use.
description: Already curious about AI for your business? We wire practical AI into your existing phones, CRM, and workflows — AI receptionists, automated intake, and time-saving automations — then train your team to run it.
deliverables: AI receptionist on your existing phone number
Training so your team owns it
buyerProfile: Local businesses spending on answering services or losing after-hours calls who want practical AI without a big enterprise project.
